description.value:
Trigger You fail, but do not critically fail, a check to Name the Anchor.

Duration constant

A failed attempt to Name the Anchor still reveals a partial truth about the target — you never whiff for nothing.

You learn one true, partial thing about the target: one of its resistances, immunities, or weaknesses; the broad category of its Anchor; or one thing it wants. The GM chooses which. The target is not Named, and you may attempt to Name it again normally. On a critical failure you learn nothing — some wounds close when you push at them.
